sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law statutory framework with customary law recognition; unitary national regime; no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) – Investment Chapter
Samoa–United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2018; United Nations Sanctions Act 2018; International Companies Regulations 1992; Registrar of International Companies Guidelines on Beneficial Ownership. The UBO register is maintained at the registered office in Samoa and is accessible to the Registrar, the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, and competent tax authorities upon lawful demand; it is not open to public inspection, and nominee shareholders and directors are permitted under the International Companies Act 1987.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Samoa registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the director's or shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (issued by the competent authority of the origin country or, if executed in Samoa, by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Samoa)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passport and proof of residential address for each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where the origin country is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and constitutional documents of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for the settlor or initial capital contributor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization required if the bank's jurisdiction is non-Hague

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and initial beneficial ownership register entries
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoa registered agent and the proposed directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization by a Samoa notary public (no apostille required for internal statutory filing)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and the Samoa domestic sanctions list under the United Nations Sanctions Act 2018. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) trigger enhanced due diligence (EDD) under Section 12 of the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018, including source-of-wealth verification and senior management approval. Registered agents must apply ongoing transaction monitoring and file suspicious transaction reports with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit. The declared banking_aml_risk_tier is Low_Risk_Standard, requiring full CDD but permitting streamlined EDD only where no PEP or adverse screening hit exists.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Office – International Company Name Reservation Desk, Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), operating in coordination with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in English or Romanized script and end with the word 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd.'; a Chinese or other non-Latin script name may be registered as a secondary name only where the charter contains a certified transliteration into English; a fully Chinese-language charter is permitted provided a notarized English translation is filed with the Registrar at incorporation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written objection with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds of distinctiveness and compliance. The Registrar must issue a determination within 14 business days. A further administrative appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the Registrar's determination. Judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa is available for procedural error or improper exercise of discretion. Practically, an expedited refiling under a new distinctive name is recommended when the objection is based on availability or confusing similitude.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for the statutory registered office. Section 94 of the International Companies Act 1987 requires a physical registered office in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent, with physical custody of the statutory registers, seal, and UBO records. Virtual or shared address services are acceptable only for non-statutory correspondence and cannot displace the licensed agent's physical office. The REIT's investment management and operational functions may lawfully be conducted from outside Samoa, subject to economic substance reporting under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, below 5% annually, for a compliant low-risk REIT holding passive income-generating real estate through a licensed registered agent with accurate UBO records. The likelihood rises to approximately 25% where AML risk indicators are triggered, unannounced physical inspections are authorized under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 to verify physical custody of statutory books, board minutes, and the beneficial ownership register.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (International Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under the International Companies Regulations 1992 (as amended)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for International Company (authorized capital up to US$100,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per the International Companies Act 1987 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Regulatory pre-clearance consent for restricted token 'Trust' in proposed REIT name
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Central Bank of Samoa and Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory pre-clearance benchmark; prevailing market application fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Samoa registered agent appointment and compliance vetting
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent (SIFA-authorized corporate services provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for annual agency and registered office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register establishment and AML/CFT onboarding (CDD file preparation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / designated AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per CDD requirements of the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening of all UBOs, directors, and signatories
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party screening data provider engaged via registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market subscription benchmark per screened individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of statutory instruments and identity documents abroad
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the country of origin of the UBO or director
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff in the origin jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of the notarized due diligence bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Samoa (or origin-country competent apostille authority)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document statutory apostille fee under the Hague Apostille Convention

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence counsel fee (pre-incorporation review of charter, UBO structure, and REIT permissibility)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa-qualified international counsel / offshore law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee market benchmark for pre-incorporation diligence and structural opinion

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Chinese-language charter and UBO declarations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per document page and certification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2016 (Samoa), Part II (Incorporation and Constitutional Documents), Part V (Registered Office and Registered Agent), and Part VI (Shares and Capital); supplemented by the International Financial Services (License) Act 2011 for any licensed financial services activity of the REIT.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa (acting through the company's SIFSA-licensed registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital. The International Companies Act 2016 permits incorporation with a single subscriber share and zero or nominal paid-up capital; no escrow, bank deposit, or capital contribution certificate is required, and non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the issued capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT: (1) the allotment of the subscriber shares set out in the Memorandum of Association be and is hereby ratified, and certificates be issued accordingly; (2) the registered office and registered agent established at the office of [Licensed Agent], Apia, Samoa, be confirmed as the registered office and registered agent of the Company; (3) [Director Name] be appointed sole Director and [Secretary Name] be appointed Secretary of the Company, each to serve in accordance with the Articles of Association; (4) the Director be and is hereby authorized to open and operate bank accounts, sign investment mandates, and instruct the registered agent; (5) the registered agent is authorized to file the incorporation record, pay statutory fees, and maintain the Company's public register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage SIFSA-Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (SIFSA register), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a resident registered agent licensed under the International Financial Services (License) Act 2011 and submit three preferred company names (ending with 'Limited' or approved suffix) for availability check against the Registrar's index; execute the agency engagement letter and collect statutory KYC documents of the beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request with three preferred names
Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
Certified passport copy and proof of address of each shareholder and director
Bank reference letter and curriculum vitae for each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A refused or reserved name (identical, confusingly similar, or offensive) may be cured by immediate re-submission of an alternative name; a name reservation is valid for the statutory period and may be renewed through the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English with REIT-consistent investment powers (fee-purchase, leasing, and management of real estate assets), limited-liability clauses, share structure with no-par or par value shares, and designation of the registered office and agent; ensure execution by the subscriber in the presence of a witness or by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (executed)
Articles of Association (executed)
Written consent of subscriber to take shares
Resolution of incorporator naming initial directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a requisition on constitutional clauses, prepare and file supplementary or amended articles within 14 days of the notice; no re-execution ceremony is required if amendments are approved by written resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Application with Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via the registered agent the completed Form 1, original executed Memorandum and Articles, statutory declaration of compliance by the agent, consent of the registered agent, and the government filing fee receipt; the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an International Company
Original executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance signed by the registered agent
Consent of registered agent to act
Filing fee remittance receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A defect notice or query from the Registrar is cured by filing a corrective statement or amended document within 30 days; failure to cure within the statutory period requires a fresh filing, with fee credit issued against the original application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Record
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of the application, the Registrar completes the electronic registration, allocates the company registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation; request a Certificate of Good Standing at the same time for banking and REIT counterparty purposes.
required_dossiers: Approved registration application
Certificate of Incorporation (output)
Extract of registered agent and registered office details (output)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains clerical or administrative errors, file a written correction application with supporting evidence, and the Registrar issues an amended certificate without re-initiating the incorporation procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Perfect First Board Governance (Subscriptions, Officers, Bank Mandates)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (meeting or written resolution) at registered office, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution adopting the First Board Resolution: ratification of share allotment, confirmation of the registered office and agent, appointment of directors and officers, and issuance of bank mandate powers; prepare the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution minutes or written consent
Consent-to-act forms for each director and the secretary
Share certificates and register of members
Register of directors, officers, and registered charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any irregularity in the corporate records is cured by a validating board resolution and corrected registers; failure to maintain statutory records may trigger a Registrar notice, which is resolved by filing the missing registers via the agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Officer Notices and Initiate REIT/SIFSA Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies (MCIL) and Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notice of appointment of directors and officers and any registered particulars; submit the REIT business description and trust or pooling documentation to SIFSA; obtain an International Financial Services Licence (or a written no-licence confirmation) if soliciting funds or conducting financial services; pay the annual IC license fee.
required_dossiers: Notice of appointment of directors and secretary
SIFSA investment business licence application
REIT trust deed or offering document and business plan
AML/CFT compliance policy meeting SIFSA-approved agent standards
Annual IC licence fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFSA issues an objection, respond in writing within 21 days with revised scope documentation; an adverse licensing determination may be appealed to the Minister responsible for international financial services under the International Financial Services (License) Act 2011.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA), Licensing Division, Apia, Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Financial Services (Investment Business / Real Estate Investment Trust) Licence issued under the International Financial Services (License) Act 2011; alternatively, a Certificate of Incorporation with no-licence confirmation for a purely passive property-holding vehicle

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - EIA Registration and Environmental Management Plan (applicable only where the REIT undertakes physical development, construction, or land-use change in Samoa); passive ownership of income-generating real estate portfolios outside Samoa is treated as exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from any Samoan-situated premises must meet national effluent quality limits (BOD5 not exceeding 20 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 30 mg/L, pH 6-9, and no visible oil or grease); stormwater discharge must not degrade receiving water quality; VOCs are not generated by passive trust holdings, but tenant fit-out work must comply with allowable ambient air standards; solid and hazardous waste must be removed and manifested by licensed contractors under the Environment Management Act 1999 and its waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and emergency evacuation plan approved by the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority for any occupied office or managed premises; building occupancy permit and structural load inspection certificate issued under the Samoa Building Code for physical premises; occupational health and safety clearance in accordance with Part VIII of the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013, covering air quality, electrical safety, and fire drills for all employees and contracted property managers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) under the Ministry for Revenue, Government of Samoa; online portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident entity not carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa is not generally required to obtain a TIN or VAGST ID. An International Company (IC) may obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption from the Samoa Revenue Authority by submitting Form EX-01, the certificate of incorporation, registered office certificate, and a statutory declaration confirming non-resident and non-domestic business activities. If the IC were to engage in any taxable activity in Samoa (which its constitutive statute ordinarily prohibits), it must file Form TIN-01 with the SRA and will receive a TIN within 5 business days; VAGST registration is triggered once the turnover threshold is met.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: An International Company registered under Samoa's International Companies Act 2001 is automatically exempt from Samoan income tax, Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST), and stamp duty on all activities, provided it does not carry on business with Samoan residents, own Samoan land, or otherwise engage in domestic taxable activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a check-the-box or fiscal classification election. An IC is tax-exempt by default; it may only become subject to ordinary taxation by converting into a domestic company under Samoa's Companies Act, which requires formal deregistration as an IC and approval from the Registrar of International Companies and the Ministry for Revenue. No hybrid mismatch elections are available under Samoan tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the VAGST Act as administered by the Samoa Revenue Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 50,000 of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period (mandatory VAGST registration threshold for persons carrying on a taxable activity in Samoa)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: There is no current statutory requirement for real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping. Taxpayers must issue serially numbered tax invoices containing the supplier's VAGST registration number, date, description, GST amount, and total consideration. Electronic invoicing may be used voluntarily, but the Samoa Revenue Authority does not operate a government clearance portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated where the goods are actually exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply and the supplier retains proof of export. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a person who is outside Samoa and who is not present in Samoa at the time of supply, as well as directly associated with exported goods; international transport services and supplies under approved incentive schemes are also eligible. The supplier must maintain contemporaneous commercial and shipping documentation demonstrating the goods left Samoa or the service was provided to a non-resident.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Samoa Revenue Authority may retrospectively claw back zero-rated VAGST where export substantiation is incomplete or false, and may impose civil penalties of up to 100% of the tax evaded plus monthly interest at 1% of the outstanding amount. Knowingly making a false declaration to obtain zero-rating or a refund is a criminal offence punishable by a fine not exceeding SAT 10,000 and/or up to three years' imprisonment. Records must be retained for a minimum of five years from the later of supply date or export date. Anti-money laundering agencies may separately enforce record-keeping and foreign exchange-related requirements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), acting as the Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1976; offshore international financial services are co-supervised by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa maintains a managed-float national currency (WST, ISO 4217 code 604). Current-account convertibility is substantially liberalized: an authorized dealer may pay genuine trade, service, and income remittances against a documented underlying transaction without prior Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) approval. Capital-account convertibility remains restricted: inbound equity subscriptions, loan drawdowns, capital repatriation, and portfolio investments must be processed through a CBS-licensed authorized dealer and are subject to declaration, economic-substance scrutiny, and, in specified cases, CBS prior approval. The subject International Company (IC) is statutorily treated as non-resident, placing it outside the domestic exchange-control perimeter: it may lawfully maintain and operate USD, NZD, AUD, and EUR accounts, hold rental proceeds offshore, and distribute dividends to non-resident investors without forced conversion into tala. Profit remittance hurdles for this REIT IC are limited to: (i) the requirement that any Samoan-domiciled distribution be executed by an authorized dealer; (ii) a board resolution and audited earning evidence demonstrating derivation from non-resident real estate business; (iii) a Ministry of Revenue tax clearance if the IC maintains any Samoan-source registration or activity; and (iv) compliance with Samoa AML/CFT Act 2007 screening of the beneficiary.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, every Samoan-resident exporter must obtain payment of the full export invoice value within six months from the date of shipment and surrender 100% of the foreign-currency proceeds to an authorized dealer within seven days of receipt; conversion into WST is mandatory at the prevailing market rate unless a general or specific exemption is granted by the Central Bank of Samoa. For this REIT IC, the obligation is not triggered by core activities because rental income from offshore real estate does not constitute a Samoan export, and the IC non-resident status exempts it from the Exchange Control Act. If the IC ever derives Samoan-source proceeds (e.g., management fees from a Samoan-resident obligor), statutory compliance would require full repatriation within the six-month window, 100% surrender, and a CBS exemption letter to preserve foreign-currency treatment.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account; FX and Treasury Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs (U.K. FCA-authorised, Gibraltar- or Bermuda-licensed e-money institutions) are legally usable by the non-resident IC for ancillary, low-value flows, but they cannot function as the primary treasury rail. Legal constraints: (i) Samoa Financial Institutions Act 2014 and AML/CFT Act 2007 criminalize unlicensed money-service business touching Samoan residents, so an EMI must be restricted strictly to non-resident counterparties; (ii) the authorized-dealer bank will not accept EMI account statements as proof of capital clearance or dividend provenance; (iii) EMIs do not provide commercial letters of credit, term-loan disbursement, or custody services required by a REIT; and (iv) global correspondent de-risking makes EMI accounts subject to abrupt suspension of dividend-related payment runs. The blueprint therefore contemplates a single tier-1 commercial bank as the principal clearing house and one fiat-backed EMI reserved solely for incidental expenses not exceeding USD 50,000 per payment.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not an absolute statutory mandate. The Central Bank of Samoa KYC Guidelines and the AML/CFT Act 2007 (as amended) permit remote onboarding through live interactive videoconference, provided identity documents are independently certified (notarized or by the SIFA-licensed registered agent) and apostilled, with two-factor verification of the directors and ultimate beneficial owners. In practice, Samoan tier-1 banks require at least one executive director or authorized signatory to complete a live compliance interview (in-branch or by video) and may require a physical visit for any UBO holding more than 25% before activating escrow or FX trading lines. Recommended protocol: the registered agent packages the certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, register of directors and members, constitutional documents, trust deed, and audited or management financials; the bank completes politically exposed persons (PEP) screening and sanctions checks; and a notarized virtual KYC pack is submitted using the bank prescribed onboarding form.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Layered or opaque beneficial-ownership chain: intermediate SPVs, fiduciary nominee shareholders, or a discretionary trust above the IC holding the real estate assets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership cascade from the REIT IC to each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner; certified register of members and directors; discretionary trust deed with a showing of the fixed or determined beneficiaries; apostilled passports and proof of residential address for all UBOs; sworn source-of-wealth declarations; bank-account references for each shareholder; and a professional attestation from the SIFA-licensed registered agent confirming the corporate records match the beneficial ownership register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undocumented or unusual initial capital injection: high-value inbound wires, third-party benefactor funding, or subscription amounts inconsistent with the REIT declared net asset value.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorizing the issue of shares and specifying the subscription amounts; executed subscription agreements; 12-month prior bank statements of each subscriber; a verified trail of the inbound remittances (MT103 records); any loan or security agreements supporting leveraged subscription; a legal opinion from Samoan counsel confirming the IC non-resident exchange-control exemption; and an independent valuation of the underlying real estate supporting the aggregate portfolio price.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographic or counterparty risk signals involving tenants, property borrowers, construction contractors, or joint-venture partners located in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions-screening certificates produced at onboarding and re-screened quarterly; adverse-media and negative-news reports for the REIT, its directors, and each material counterparty; a constitutional prohibition or compliance certificate confirming the REIT will not transact with restricted persons; executed leases, sale-purchase agreements, or construction contracts with full legal names, addresses, and tax identifiers; and land-registry extracts in the property jurisdictions evidencing clean title.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividend distribution anomalies: distributions exceeding available distributable reserves, circular transfers among related offshore entities, or payments to beneficiaries that cannot be reconciled with audited rental performance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited annual financial statements or management accounts demonstrating distributable earnings; asset-level rent roll and lease expiries; a distribution policy approved by the board; minutes of the board or trustee meeting declaring each dividend; per-payment SWIFT instructions using accepted dividend purpose codes; and an independent property manager report confirming cash-flow aggregation and expense deductions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital contributions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 through a CBS-licensed authorized dealer. Recommended remittance data: purpose code 5211 Direct Investment, Equity Capital (BPM6-aligned) or the bank designated International Company subscription code; ordering customer (fields 50K/50F) must be the named subscribing shareholder; beneficiary (field 59) must be the IC legal name and Samoan account number as set out in the bank Standard Settlement Instructions (no IBAN applies); field 70 must reference the board resolution and subscription agreement (e.g., SUB/07-REIT/2025/014); field 72 must be marked INSTRBEN/NOT AVAILABLE or equivalent to prevent unintended free-of-payment delivery. The compliance hold for source-of-funds verification is typically three to ten business days. The bank will require: the executed subscription agreement; the share register update; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements for each investor; the IC certificate of good standing; and a declaration of non-resident status confirming exemption from exchange control.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade and portfolio disbursements clear on three rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for operating payments, rent-roll aggregation, insurance, advisory fees, and distributions below USD 250,000, with purpose code GRDS Goods and Services or DIV Distributed Income as applicable; (ii) SWIFT MT103/MT202 for authenticated FX settlements of real estate acquisition deposits where the underlying purchase agreement is attached; and (iii) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) and standby LCs (ISP98) for construction milestone payments exceeding USD 250,000, issued by the authorized-dealer bank under the IC secured facility and settled on presentation of compliant documents (commercial invoice, signed progress certificate, insurance policy, inspection certificates). Dividend distributions to non-resident investors must be aggregated into a single MT103 payment schedule per distribution date, with the paying agent statement and the board dividend declaration lodged with the bank; ACH is permissible only for any Samoan-resident recipient, which the IC constitutive documents should preclude, making SWIFT the exclusive outbound dividend rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forward contracts (USD/NZD/AUD cross pairs) with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer, tenor up to 12 months, documented against the REIT committed rental income or acquisition pipeline exposure.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the WST, executed through non-resident counterparties, with settlement in USD outside Samoa and no WST delivery within the domestic banking system.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps aligning the currency of the REIT property debt with the currency of the underlying rental revenue streams (e.g., USD fixed-rate versus NZD floating-rate), documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement.

Interest-rate caps, collars, and plain-vanilla interest-rate swaps on term-loan facilities financing the real estate portfolio, provided the bank records the facility mark-to-market exposure under CBS prudential guidelines.

Purchased plain-vanilla European FX options as downside protection for large scheduled capital expenditures (acquisition completions, construction tranches), with premiums settled from offshore funds and no exotic or leveraged structures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return of the International Company (name, registered office, registered agent, share capital summary, directors and members entries)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 calendar month after the anniversary of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty accrues; after 3 months of default the Registrar issues a strike-off notice and the IC may be dissolved administratively, with consequential loss of limited-liability status and vesting of assets in the Public Trustee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company government fee (renewal of SIFA tax-exempt status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable in advance on or before the anniversary of incorporation; covers the succeeding 12-month licence year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual fee accrues penalty interest; continued non-payment beyond 6 months triggers administrative strike-off, cancellation of the tax-exempt certificate, and disqualification of directors

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-ownership re-confirmation and AML/CFT continuing-diligence declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent (records inspectable by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary; re-run contemporaneously on any share transfer, issue, or redemption during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Breach of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2007; body-corporate fines up to WST 200,000 and agent-licence suspension for persistent non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual economic-substance confirmation (applicable only if the REIT is engaged in a relevant activity under OECD Inclusive Framework commitments, e.g., holding-company or leasing activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies (MCIL), submitted through the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual return, within 1 calendar month after the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Deficient substance position triggers a rectification notice (typically 30 days); unresolved findings may lead to automatic information exchange with unitholder tax-residence jurisdictions and administrative penalties

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit for a standard Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987; the duty is limited to keeping true-and-fair accounting records. A compulsory audit arises only when (a) the REIT is a listed issuer or makes a public offering under the Securities Act 1995, (b) the IC holds a SIFA-regulated financial-services licence requiring audited accounts, (c) shareholders holding at least 10% of voting shares petition the Registrar to direct an audit, or (d) a lender, custodian, or trust deed requires an audit opinion.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed local GAAP; accounting records must reflect the financial position with reasonable accuracy. ICs may adopt IFRS or US GAAP; a real-estate portfolio is normally presented under IFRS, particularly IAS 40 (Investment Property), IFRS 16 (Leases), and IFRS 10 (Consolidation).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa maintains no public beneficial-ownership registry. The licensed registered agent must hold a confidential beneficial-ownership register under the AML/CFT Act 2007 and perform an annual KYC re-confirmation of each natural-person beneficial owner of the REIT within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary. Any share transfer, allotment, or redemption must be reflected in the agent-held UBO register on the transaction date, supported by updated CDD material. For a listed REIT, public-shareholder disclosure under the Securities Act 1995 overrides the private UBO protocol.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and director resolutions
Agent-held Register of Beneficial Owners (AML/CFT Act 2007)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 - 1,800 per annum for a licensed registered agent and registered-office service for a low-risk IC/REIT vehicle
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not legally required for a standard exempt IC; USD 4,000 - 8,000 per annum if a by-choice certified audit is commissioned for REIT investor reporting

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (IC) de jure tax-exempt under Section 114 of the International Companies Act 1987; 27% standard corporate rate under the Income Tax Act 2012 applies only if the IC loses its exempt status by carrying on business in Samoa or becoming Samoan-resident.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption: no Samoan income tax, no capital gains tax, no stamp duty on IC instruments, no withholding tax on IC dividends/interest/royalties, no exchange control on non-resident share transfers, and no minimum capital requirement. Annual cost is limited to the government fee (approximately USD 250–2,500) and the licensed resident agent's service fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form 7 under the International Companies Act 1987 and the International Companies (Forms) Regulations), filed with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) via the Samoa Companies Online Registry. A corporate income tax return is NOT filed because an exempt IC is outside the Samoa income tax base.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: File within 28 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the IC as registered, including the required suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.'.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must be reserved and approved before filing; the resident agent files on behalf of non-resident beneficial owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique IC registration number issued by the Registrar (e.g., 'IC-12345').
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be cited in all banking, AML, and agent correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address in Samoa, which must be located at the premises of the licensed resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign address cannot be used; the licensed resident agent's office is the legal service address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and license number of the Samoan-licensed resident agent (corporate or individual).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent is the sole point of contact for the Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, currency denomination, and par value per share class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any currency is permitted; there is no minimum paid-up capital; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, and nationalities of all directors; at least one director is required; corporate directors are permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may reside anywhere; no Samoan residency or nationality requirement applies to IC directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Alphabetical register of shareholders with registered addresses and the number and class of shares held.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The public register shows the shareholder name and address; underlying beneficial ownership is disclosed to the resident agent for AML/CFT and kept in the agent's BO file, not the public register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Declaration of No Domestic Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC has not carried on business within Samoa, has no Samoan-situs real estate, and has not derived Samoan-source income during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a REIT IC, all property assets must be located outside Samoa; holding Samoan land would forfeit the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the annual fee tiered by authorized capital (standard USD 250 for capital up to USD 10,000; USD 1,000 for capital up to USD 1,000,000; USD 2,500 for capital above USD 1,000,000).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment is remitted by the resident agent from client funds; the agent confirms settlement in the filing portal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature, date, and certification by the licensed resident agent attesting to the accuracy of the annual return and compliance with AML/CFT obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent signs as the authorized representative of the non-resident principals and must retain supporting KYC records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: flat late penalty of USD 100 per return. Non-payment of the annual government fee for 3 months after the anniversary date may trigger administrative strike-off under Part X of the International Companies Act 1987 with forfeiture of Samoan-situs assets. Reinstatement requires payment of arrears plus a USD 50 reinstatement fee. A false annual return attracts a criminal fine of up to WST 5,000 and imprisonment of up to 2 years. No income tax late-filing penalty applies because the tax-exempt IC is outside the CIT regime.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (Income Tax Act 2012, Form CIT-01) filed through the Samoa Ministry for Revenue portal. NOT APPLICABLE to a tax-exempt IC; this form is engaged only if the entity loses IC status and is taxed as an ordinary Samoan-resident company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the tax year (31 December), or within 6 months after an approved substituted accounting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa Taxpayer Registration Number, company legal name, address, and accounting period end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-controlled taxable entity must appoint a Samoan tax agent for e-file registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of assessable income derived from Samoa, deductions, capital allowances, and net taxable income at 27%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Samoan-source income is assessable; foreign rental income of a non-resident company is outside the Samoan tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduction of prior-year tax losses carried forward, subject to a 5-year limitation and continuity-of-ownership tests.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are ring-fenced to the Samoan entity and cannot be surrendered to or from foreign shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT at 27%, application of foreign tax credits and instalment payments, and final balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits arise only under a double tax agreement or a unilateral credit provision; Samoa's treaty network is minimal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: an initial penalty of 10% of the assessed tax plus a 2% monthly compounding surcharge (capped at 100%); late payment: 5% immediate penalty plus 2% per month; tax evasion penalties up to 200% of the tax shortfall; directors may be personally liable for withheld employee and withholding taxes held in trust.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends and capital distributions paid by a tax-exempt International Company (explicit statutory exemption in Section 114 of the International Companies Act 1987). If the payer were an ordinary Samoan-resident company, the statutory dividend withholding tax rate for non-resident shareholders is 15% under the Income Tax Act 2012.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not required for IC distributions because the statutory rate is already zero. If a taxable Samoan company were involved, the non-resident recipient must submit to the payer, before distribution: (1) Form IRD-102 Non-Resident Withholding Tax Relief Claim; (2) a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the residence country's tax authority, legalized or apostilled if required; (3) a statement of the applicable DTA article and a Limitation on Benefits declaration; and (4) confirmation of beneficial ownership. The Samoa Ministry for Revenue must issue a written approval before the reduced rate is applied. In practice, Samoa's comprehensive DTA network is very limited, so the domestic 15% rate is usually the effective floor.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Paid by an exempt IC: 0% statutory rate for both royalties and interest. Paid by a taxable Samoan-resident company: statutory 15% for royalties and 15% for interest to non-residents; treaty-reduced rates (where an applicable DTA is in force) typically range from 5% to 10% for royalties and 0% to 10% for interest, conditioned on TRC submission and substance/beneficial-ownership requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No local-currency threshold applies to an exempt International Company because it is outside the Samoan income tax base. For an ordinary taxable Samoan-resident company, the Income Tax Act 2012 (Sections 40–42) requires related-party cross-border transactions to be priced at arm's length; Samoa does not prescribe a statutory Local/Master File threshold, but the Commissioner may order contemporaneous TP documentation where annual related-party turnover exceeds WST 5,000,000 or where a transaction involves a low-tax jurisdiction. An IC that holds foreign real estate through a related SPV should nonetheless maintain an internal transfer pricing memorandum to support management fees, debt financing terms, and property acquisition/sale prices in the event of an economic substance review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa, as a no-or-only-nominal-tax jurisdiction under the OECD/G20 BEPS Action 5 and EU listing processes, must demonstrate that the IC regime is not harmful only where ICs engaged in geographically mobile services (headquarters, distribution, services, financing, leasing, banking, insurance, shipping, and DPP activities) maintain substantial economic presence. A Samoan IC cannot rely solely on its registered office and agent. A REIT IC must evidence, where managed from Samoa: physical premises, qualified local employees or delegates, recurrent board minutes and strategic decisions in Samoa, and expenditure commensurate with income. A purely passive IC holding foreign income-generating real estate, with no Samoan management activity, records, or employees, is treated as low-risk for ESR purposes but remains subject to the Samaritan AML/BO recordkeeping obligations of the licensed resident agent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Forfeiture of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC carries on business inside Samoa, acquires or develops Samoan-situs land, derives Samoan-source income, or uses the IC structure to conceal taxable Samoan activity while claiming the Section 114 exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the tax exemption; assessment as an ordinary resident company at 27% on Samoan-source income; penalty of at least 20% of the tax shortfall plus 2% monthly compound interest; deregistration of the International Company certificate by the Registrar; cancellation of the licensed agent's authority to service the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally and jointly liable for taxes collected or withheld and not remitted (trust fund doctrine); civil restitution for diverted corporate assets; the Supreme Court may impose travel bans and asset freezes pending investigation; criminal tax evasion is punishable by up to 7 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a 'letterbox' IC with no real governance, no economic activity test, no beneficial ownership file at the resident agent, and no documented business purpose; a REIT IC that holds foreign property without trustee resolutions, SPV rationalization, or any revenue-linked expenditure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OECD FHTP and EU listing consequences for Samoa; the Ministry may impose a Significant Economic Presence filing and penalties; the Registrar may strike off the IC under Part X; the Financial Services Authority may fine the licensed agent up to WST 500,000 for servicing shell entities without substance review; the anti-money laundering supervisor may issue a direction requiring divestment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a struck-off IC may be disqualified from acting as directors of any Samoan company for up to 5 years; personal fines up to WST 100,000 for causing the entity to breach substance conditions; the court may impose a travel ban pending the completion of an FIU/Registrar investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the true beneficial owner of the REIT IC; failing to maintain or update BO records at the resident agent; processing dividend or redemption wires without sanctions screening; accepting third-party funds for share subscriptions without verifying source of funds under the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007 (as amended).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fine up to WST 500,000 for money-laundering offences; the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze bank accounts, suspend the resident agent's license, and the Registrar may strike off the IC; confiscation orders may extend to the underlying real estate portfolio held through the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and officers are liable to imprisonment of up to 14 years and personal fines of up to WST 200,000; personal civil liability for dishonest assistance in laundering rental proceeds; court-ordered travel bans and passport surrender during FIU and criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return / Pay Annual Fee
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-filing of the annual return within 28 days of the anniversary of incorporation or non-payment of the annual government fee, with the resident agent having issued written default notices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Flat late-filing penalty of USD 100; after 3 months of continuous default, automatic strike-off from the International Companies Register with forfeiture of assets situated in Samoa; reinstatement only by court order or Registrar's discretion upon payment of all arrears plus a USD 50 reinstatement fee.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a struck-off IC are jointly liable for unpaid annual fees up to USD 500; the Registrar may prohibit the directors from incorporating a new IC until arrears are settled; prolonged default supports a director disqualification order enforced through a travel restriction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly signing a false annual return, supplying false shareholder or director particulars, or falsely declaring that the IC holds no Samoan real estate and has no local business presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine of up to WST 5,000 and imprisonment of up to 2 years under the International Companies Act 1987; the Registrar may strike off the company on just and equitable grounds; the Ministry for Revenue may issue a restitution order for any resulting tax loss.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Full personal criminal liability of the signing director; civil restitution of any tax avoided; prohibition from holding office in any Samoan company for up to 10 years; the Supreme Court may issue a travel ban and asset freeze pending trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Collective Investment Scheme / REIT Regulatory Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing REIT units to the public (including foreign retail investors) or accepting subscription funds without a license from the Samoa Financial Services Authority under the relevant securities and collective investment rules; declaring or distributing dividends from unrealized revaluation gains or in the absence of audited real earnings; acting as a trustee or fund manager without statutory authorization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist order from the FSA; administrative fine of up to WST 250,000; the underlying property portfolio may be placed under a receiver; subscription agreements may be voidable; the directors must refund investor monies within a court-supervised timetable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for all investor losses; criminal liability for unauthorized securities dealing with imprisonment of up to 5 years; the FSA may seek a personal asset freeze and travel ban to secure restitution and prevent dissipation of investor funds.
